name: Minimax Path Formulation
description: Translate the two-machine flow shop makespan into its exact mathematical equivalent: finding a permutation that minimizes the maximum over all split points k of the sum of p1 for indices 1 to k plus the sum of p2 for indices k to j. This removes all scheduling terminology (machines, jobs, phases) and presents a minimax array problem that LLMs struggle to map back to Johnson's rule.
